methodology: Cumulative N4 audit assembled from several reconstructed JLPT curricula. Integrated entries point to stable ChakuChaku grammar IDs. Planned entries are original canonical definitions ready to be promoted in reviewed exercise batches. Lexical items and transparent compositions are recorded separately instead of inflating the grammar SRS.
sourceRefPolicy: Entry sourceRefs are non-exhaustive supporting evidence, not a claim that every occurrence in every source was mapped. The official description supplies the ability scope because the JLPT publishes no itemized grammar list; Bunpro is used as a broad coverage benchmark.

planned.name: Showing signs of a feeling
planned.meaning: Describe observable signs of another person's feeling or sensation.

planned.name: Tendency toward a feeling
planned.meaning: Describe someone as characteristically prone or sensitive to a feeling.

planned.name: Want someone to do
planned.meaning: Express a wish for another person to perform an action.

planned.name: Thank someone for an action
planned.meaning: Express gratitude for something another person did for the speaker's side.

planned.name: Apologize for an action
planned.meaning: Apologize for doing something or causing a situation.

planned.name: Very polite request
planned.meaning: Ask very politely whether someone could do something for you.

planned.name: Glad that something happened
planned.meaning: Express relief or satisfaction that an action or event occurred.

planned.name: Blunt benefactive
planned.meaning: Express doing something for an animal, subordinate, or other recipient in a deliberately casual register.

planned.name: Deadline with までに
planned.meaning: Set the latest time by which an action must be completed.

planned.name: Just about to do
planned.meaning: Place an action immediately before it begins.

planned.name: Right in the middle of doing
planned.meaning: Place an action at the moment it is in progress.

planned.name: Have just done
planned.meaning: Place an action immediately after its completion.

planned.name: Have only just done
planned.meaning: Present a completed action as recent from the speaker's perspective.

planned.pattern: Vた / Vない / い-adjective + まま; な-adjective + なまま; noun + のまま
planned.name: Leave a state unchanged
planned.meaning: Express that a state remains unchanged while something else happens.

planned.name: At regular intervals
planned.meaning: Express that something occurs at each stated interval.

planned.pattern: stem + そうな / そうに
planned.name: Modify with an apparent quality
planned.meaning: Use an appearance judgment before a noun or as an adverb.

planned.pattern: verb / い-adjective plain form + ようだ; な-adjective + なようだ; noun + のようだ
planned.name: Inference with ようだ
planned.meaning: Present a conclusion drawn from evidence or the situation.

planned.pattern: verb / い-adjective plain form + ような / ように; な-adjective + なような / なように; noun + のような / のように
planned.name: Resemblance with よう
planned.meaning: Compare a noun, quality, or manner to a concrete example.

planned.pattern: plain form / noun + みたいだ
planned.name: Casual resemblance or inference
planned.meaning: Express that something seems or looks like something in conversational language.

planned.name: Apparently or characteristically
planned.meaning: Report an evidence-based impression or describe something as typical of its kind.

planned.pattern: verb / い-adjective plain form + のに; な-adjective / noun + なのに
planned.name: Unexpected contrast with のに
planned.meaning: Contrast an actual result with what would normally be expected.

planned.name: Even if
planned.meaning: State that a result remains true regardless of the condition.

planned.pattern: dictionary form / noun の + ために
planned.name: Purpose with ために
planned.meaning: State the intended purpose for which an action is performed.

planned.pattern: plain form / noun の + ために
planned.name: Cause with ために
planned.meaning: Present a cause, often one with an unfavorable result.

planned.name: Hope with といい
planned.meaning: Express hope that a desirable situation will occur.

planned.name: Focused explanation
planned.meaning: Nominalize a clause and identify or emphasize the information that explains it.

planned.name: Nominalized quoted content
planned.meaning: Treat the content of a statement as a noun-like fact or idea.

planned.pattern: dictionary / ない form + ように言う
planned.name: Report an instruction
planned.meaning: Report that someone told or asked another person to do something.

planned.name: Adjective quality nouns
planned.meaning: Turn an adjective into a noun that names the degree or quality itself.

planned.name: Extent with ほど
planned.meaning: Express an approximate extent or the degree to which something is true.

planned.name: Nothing but
planned.meaning: Present something as occurring or being selected almost exclusively.

planned.name: Just by
planned.meaning: State that one limited condition or action is sufficient for a result.

planned.pattern: A とか B とか
planned.name: Casual representative examples
planned.meaning: Give informal non-exhaustive examples from a broader set.

planned.pattern: sound / smell / taste / feeling + がする
planned.name: Perceived sensation
planned.meaning: Describe a sound, smell, taste, physical sensation, or impression that is perceived.

planned.pattern: verb / い-adjective plain form + 場合は; な-adjective + な場合は; noun + の場合は
planned.name: In the event that
planned.meaning: Specify what applies in a particular possible case or situation.

planned.pattern: material でできる / で作る
planned.name: Made of a visible material
planned.meaning: Identify the material from which something is made when that material remains recognizable.

planned.pattern: material からできる / から作る
planned.name: Made from a transformed material
planned.meaning: Identify a source material that is transformed in the finished product.

planned.name: Honorific language
planned.meaning: Raise another person's actions or state when respect is required.

planned.name: Humble language
planned.meaning: Lower the speaker's or in-group's actions to show respect toward someone else.

planned.pattern: ございます / でございます
planned.name: Very polite existence and copula
planned.meaning: Use the formal polite equivalents of ある and です.

planned.pattern: お / ご + stem + になる
planned.name: Productive honorific action
planned.meaning: Respectfully describe another person's action with the productive honorific pattern.

planned.pattern: お / ご + stem + する
planned.name: Productive humble action
planned.meaning: Humbly describe the speaker's action performed for or toward a respected person.

planned.pattern: お / ご + stem + ください
planned.name: Respectful request
planned.meaning: Ask someone respectfully to perform an action.

planned.pattern: いらっしゃる / おっしゃる / なさる / くださる / 召し上がる / ご覧になる
planned.name: Special honorific verbs
planned.meaning: Use conventional honorific verbs for common actions rather than a regular productive form.

planned.pattern: 参る / 申す / いたす / いただく / 拝見する / おる
planned.name: Special humble verbs
planned.meaning: Use conventional humble verbs for common actions by the speaker or their in-group.

planned.name: Wondering with かな
planned.meaning: Express an internal question, uncertainty, or a tentative wish.

planned.name: Wondering with かしら
planned.meaning: Express wondering in a traditionally feminine conversational style.

planned.name: Casual question with かい
planned.meaning: Form a conversational yes-or-no question, often in masculine or older speech.

planned.pattern: ではないか / じゃないか
planned.name: Confirmation or forceful suggestion
planned.meaning: Seek agreement, challenge an assumption, or urge a shared action depending on context.

planned.pattern: plain form / noun の + 頃
planned.name: Around the time when
planned.meaning: Refer approximately to a period or to the time when something happens.

planned.name: For doing
planned.meaning: Mark the purpose or practical use for which something is needed or suitable.

planned.name: Not easily
planned.meaning: Express that an expected result does not happen easily or quickly.

planned.name: Look or appear
planned.meaning: Describe how a person or thing appears to the observer.

planned.name: Emotionally difficult to do
planned.meaning: Describe an action as difficult because of emotional, social, or situational resistance.

planned.name: Be settled by
planned.meaning: Express that a problem is resolved or that no more than the stated action is necessary.

planned.pattern: dictionary form / noun の + 予定だ
planned.name: Scheduled plan
planned.meaning: State that an action or event is planned or scheduled.

planned.pattern: question word + ～たらいいですか / ～ばいいですか
planned.name: Ask what one should do
planned.meaning: Ask for instructions or advice about the appropriate action to take.

planned.name: Need a thing
planned.meaning: State that a particular thing is necessary.

planned.name: Cause with the connective form
planned.meaning: Connect a state or event to the result it causes.

planned.name: Negative connective form
planned.meaning: Connect a negative state or action to another clause, often as its cause or background.

planned.pattern: dictionary / ない form + ことにしている
planned.name: Personal rule or maintained decision
planned.meaning: Express a decision that the speaker keeps as a regular habit or policy.

planned.pattern: dictionary / ない form + ことになっている
planned.name: Established rule or arrangement
planned.meaning: Express an external rule, schedule, or arrangement that is already in force.

planned.name: Spontaneous visibility and audibility
planned.meaning: Express that something can naturally be seen or heard without deliberate effort.

planned.name: Humbly receive an action
planned.meaning: Describe receiving another person's action as a favor in humble language.

planned.name: Honorific benefactive action
planned.meaning: Respectfully describe someone doing an action for the speaker or their in-group.

excludedCandidates.reason: Lexical adverbs belong in the vocabulary inventory, not in grammar SRS.
Standalone conjunctions are vocabulary items unless an exercise targets a productive construction.
This is a lexical expression rather than a productive grammar pattern.
These are transparently assembled from quotation plus passive, hearing, or hearsay patterns already represented.
Only one audited list places this idiomatic evaluation at N4, so it should be reconsidered with N3 rather than asserted as N4 core.
The request follows regularly from てくれる plus a negative question and does not need a separate SRS unit.
The existing superlative point already teaches selecting one item within a group.
The existing contrastive は point covers this discourse pattern.
The existing degree and frequency adverb systems already track these constructions.
